svg.text: Lock-in amplifier on a breadboard (top view, row 1 at the top)
Wires are drawn straight to show where they start and end. Lay the real wires round the chips, not over them.
Stage 1. Rows 3 to 8, right: 5 V supply
Stage 4. Rows 5 to 14, left: LED driver
Stage 7. Rows 51 to 58: filter and output
